_comment: Helping members of your own alliance online. Resources go by cart: one shipment carries at most carry_per_keep_level times the sender's keep level, takes as long as a march, and whatever the receiver's storage can't hold is lost. Defenders march to the ally's castle, help defend it against attacks for station_hours, then walk home; the sender can call them back early. Soldiers away from home eat nothing, like armies on a march.
